brief:
The British government has been accused of hypocrisy after saying pupils should not display Palestine flags in school, Middle East Eye reported. The government has promoted displaying Ukraine flags despite taking a stricter stance on Palestinian solidarity symbols among students.

The contradiction drew criticism over the differential treatment of the two cases, with observers pointing to the government's apparent willingness to encourage support for Ukraine while restricting expressions of solidarity with Palestine in educational settings.

title: Britain bars schoolchildren from displaying Palestine flags
